conflictDisposition.taskState: Existing Quest records and Solver only; no upstream task ledger or scheduler.
conflictDisposition.approval: Existing user authority and independent Quest verification; no fixed failed-attempt escalation.
conflictDisposition.publication: Existing land and publish owners only; no automatic upstream commit or PR pipeline.
conflictDisposition.verification: Fresh applicable retained evidence; no rerun triggered merely by another message.
conflictDisposition.learning: Current regression, contract or documentation owner; append-only Quest findings, no personal memory database.
conflictDisposition.baselines: One-way ratchets; never increase or exempt a baseline to accommodate a lesson.
conflictDisposition.editing: Serena navigation only; authors use the normal reviewed edit path.
conflictDisposition.unavailable: Report a named unavailable capability; no replacement version or fabricated evidence.
